title: Zeus Team Award for the risk-evaluation API
summary: The fraud and risk tech org gave me and two other engineers its award for exceptional project delivery, for creating the risk-evaluation API and putting its first use case into production.
what_i_did: Designed the generic risk document the API runs on and worked with the platform team on the first launch.
what_changed: The award was signed by the org's tech director, and the first use case routes risky customer contacts automatically.
